french_body.usage: UI elements, translation text, buttons, dashboard data

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing. The text needs air to breathe. The reading interface must feel like an open manuscript, not a cramped PDF.
spacing_and_layout.bento_dashboard: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-6 md:gap-8

cards.style: bg-surface border border-border/60 rounded-xl p-8 shadow-sm transition-all hover:shadow-md hover:-translate-y-1

buttons.primary: bg-[#9E4A35] text-white rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-sans font-medium hover:bg-[#9E4A35]/90 transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#9E4A35] text-[#9E4A35] rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-sans font-medium hover:bg-[#9E4A35]/5 transition-colors

navigation.style: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 glass border-b border-border/40 py-4
navigation.active_link: text-primary font-medium after:content-[''] after:absolute after:-bottom-2 after:left-0 after:w-full after:h-0.5 after:bg-primary

reading_controls.style: fixed bottom-8 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 bg-surface border border-border shadow-lg rounded-full px-6 py-3 flex items-center gap-6 z-40 backdrop-blur-md bg-white/90

dashboard.description: Daily control center. Focuses on what needs to be learned today and the 5-day Tamrin cycle.
structure: - Main Card (col-span-1 md:col-span-4 lg:col-span-4 row-span-2): Plan of the day (Abyat to learn/review)
- Tamrin Card (col-span-1 md:col-span-4 lg:col-span-2 row-span-1): Next 5-day cycle countdown
- Stats Card (col-span-1 md:col-span-2 lg:col-span-2 row-span-1): Progress across all moutoun
Library Section (Horizontal scroll or simple list of active texts)

reading_view.description: The emotional core of the app. Distraction-free reading experience.
structure: Minimal Header (Back button, Title, Settings toggle)
Content Area (Split view desktop, Stacked or Toggle mobile):
- Right Column (RTL): Arabic text in Amiri, massive size, generous line-height.
- Left Column (LTR): French translation in Manrope, muted color, smaller size.
Floating Action Bar: Play audio, Zoom In/Out, Toggle Translation
Side panel or distinct chat page.
AI messages: warm sand background. Scholarly tone.

motion.reading_scroll: Lenis smooth scroll is MANDATORY for the reading view to make it feel luxurious.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure Arabic text (#0D0C0A) against background (#F8F6F0) exceeds APCA readability standards for prolonged reading.
accessibility.test_ids: MANDATORY: Add `data-testid` to all interactive elements (e.g., `data-testid='zoom-in-btn'`, `data-testid='play-audio-btn'`, `data-testid='start-tamrin-btn'`).

subtle_parchment.description: Use sparingly as a blended background for hero sections or the Tamrin mode entry screen to give a physical paper feel. Opacity 20% max.

abstract_ink.description: Use for empty states, 'No tasks today', or as an abstract graphic on the Library screen.

instructions_to_main_agent: INSTALLATION: Add Google Fonts: 'Cormorant Garamond', 'Manrope', and 'Amiri'. Add @phosphor-icons/react for elegant duotone icons. Add lenis for smooth scrolling.
TAILWIND CONFIG: Add the custom colors (primary: #9E4A35, background: #F8F6F0, surface: #FFFFFF, text: #1A1816) and fonts to tailwind.config.js.
BILINGUAL SUPPORT: The reading view MUST support RTL (dir='rtl') for the Arabic text blocks. Ensure the flex/grid layouts don't break when direction changes.
READING CONTROLS: Implement the zoom controls by updating a global or local state that changes the Tailwind text size classes on the Arabic text container (e.g., text-3xl -> text-4xl -> text-5xl).
TAMRIN MODE: This should feel like a 'special event' screen. Use the parchment background, center the content, use the Terracotta primary color heavily here.

COMPONENT AVOIDANCE: Do NOT use standard Shadcn cards for the reading view. The text must flow directly on the background or a very subtle paper-like container without heavy borders. Use Shadcn ONLY for forms, dialogs, and dropdowns.
